description: List an account's subscriptions. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the job finishing. When the job completes, the result is ALWAYS written to the caller-supplied output_tsv_path, never inline. Requires account_id. Zuora's own endpoint (GET /v1/subscriptions/accounts/{account_id}) pages internally at 40 subscriptions per call -- this verb follows that pagination automatically up to the effective row limit. The row limit below is entirely our own policy. Defaults to 500 to avoid exhausting API request limits and disk. To fetch more, pass acknowledge_default_limit_override=true together with an explicit row_limit (up to 5000) -- both are required together, and a row_limit above 5000 is refused rather than silently clamped. Prefer selecting on stable subscription/account IDs downstream over billing-contact PII fields when the goal is validation.
embedding_description: List an account's subscriptions -- current/prior subscriptions and their recurring plans -- to a workspace TSV, up to 5,000 with an acknowledged override, 500 by default. Dispatches asynchronously: a job_id comes back at once, the TSV handle lands moments later. Review a customer's subscription portfolio; prefer stable ID fields over PII for validation reads.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the listing -- the TSV handle (path, columns, row_count, truncated) arrives separately, as its own message, when the job completes.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the listing was queued -- do not present job_id/status as the listing result. Acknowledge the request is in flight; the TSV handle lands in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, confirm the written path, the row_count, and the column list. The file reflects sensitive billing content (data_sensitivity 0.5) -- name the path for downstream use but do not inline its contents. If truncated is true, warn that the listing hit the effective limit and point to a higher acknowledged row_limit (up to 5000) if more is needed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List a Zuora account's subscriptions and write the result to a tab-separated file in the operator's workspace, up to an acknowledged override ceiling.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params: missing account_id/output_tsv_path, the path's parent directory does not exist, acknowledge_default_limit_override and row_limit were not given together, or row_limit exceeded the 5000 hard cap. zuora.export_path_refused: the path is not absolute, not a .tsv, or not contained under any operator-configured export_allowed_roots entry (an empty export_allowed_roots refuses every export by default). zuora.object_not_found: no account with that id exists. zuora.auth_failed: the OAuth client credentials were rejected.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: zuora.invalid_params naming the override pair: pass BOTH acknowledge_default_limit_override=true and an explicit row_limit, or neither (for the 500-record default); a row_limit above 5000 is refused outright, not clamped. zuora.export_path_refused: pass an ABSOLUTE path ending in .tsv under a configured workspace root; if export_allowed_roots is empty, add the operator's export directory to the zuora_plugin config and reload the plugin config. zuora.object_not_found: verify the account_id via data_query or get_object.
